reason: The cited definition is misapplied outside its stated scope: def-lefschetz-fixed-point-data defines the sign formula for a smooth self-map f of a compact orientable manifold M, but here T(y)=Ay is a self-map of the noncompact chart vector space. This leaf supplies no compact orientable M on which T is a self-map; restricting T to a small ball does not repair this because generally T(B) is not contained in B. Thus the definition alone does not entail J(T,0)=sgn det(I-DT_0) in the asserted local setting; an allowed local-index/degree theorem or an explicit valid reduction is missing.
